entities.summary: Christian Pedersen Horrebow was a Danish astronomer of the 18th century. He was a son of Peder Horrebow, whom he succeeded as director of the observatory associated with the University of Copenhagen. He was himself succeeded by Thomas Bugge. Christian Horrebow was a astronomers & cosmologists from Copenhagen (1718-04-15, Copenhagen–1776-09-15). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
